ruleDefinitions.name: VBScript Payload Stored in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects VBScript content stored into registry keys as seen being used by UNC2452 group Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion.*") AND (Details = RGX(".*vbscript\\:.*") OR Details = RGX(".*jscript\\:.*") OR Details = RGX(".*mshtml\\,.*") OR Details = RGX(".*RunHTMLApplication.*") OR Details = RGX(".*Execute\\(.*") OR Details = RGX(".*CreateObject.*") OR Details = RGX(".*window\\\.close.*"))) AND  NOT (registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Installer\\\\UserData\\\\.*") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Primary\\ Interop\\ Assemblies\\\\Microsoft\\\.mshtml\\\.dll.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\<\\\\Microsoft\\\.mshtml\\,fileVersion\\=.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\_mshtml\\_dll\\_.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\<\\\\Microsoft\\\.mshtml\\,culture\\=.*"))))
